name: wave-2 crucible

source.anchor: whole-wave adversarial review before any merge word; carries the wave-1 B1/B2 lessons as standing checks

targets: adversarial review of W2-S1..S5 branches against their crucible_criteria
verify every acceptance claim against its evidence class; re-run cheap checks; refuse claims without receipts

acceptance.predicate: every wave leg reviewed against its own crucible_criteria; verdict per criterion
B1 standing check: every leg's branch HEAD is ahead of base with named-file commits - uncommitted worktree state is a BLOCK
B2 standing check: every receipt's durable-state claims verified against git facts
gui_required acceptance not yet measured is recorded UNKNOWN, never assumed
builds nothing, fixes nothing - findings only

crucible_criteria: the crucible reviews; it never patches - a fix authored here is itself a BLOCK
verdicts cite file:line or receipt path; no anchor, no verdict
the S1 seam guard (fix/memory-store-recovery) is independently re-verified against the actual store.py diff
note: F1-shaped gate on the whole wave. Merge stays Joe's word; a green crucible receipt is a precondition, not a permission.
